title: Worker-level tests for the explicit source-root capture: not-recordable end, waiting without attempts, follow-up install and delivery, measured-unchanged delivered with emission on
outcome: Worker-level tests drive the explicit source-root capture through the real observation worker for: (a) emission off with an unchanged root -> the job ends with its explanation and nothing is sent; (b) a capture waiting for another turn longer than the attempt budget is rescheduled without spending attempts and is measured once the turn ends; (c) an unrecorded_change refusal with details installs one follow-up that is delivered under its own key, and a refused follow-up installs none; (d) with emission on, a measured_unchanged capture is delivered and receipted as sighting_only.
acceptance: Worker-level tests for the explicit source-root capture: not-recordable end, waiting without attempts, follow-up install and delivery, measured-unchanged delivered with emission on is done
disposal_reason: Fable2 #1217 triage at master 8f544b4553a14b87a0c7a55fb82d67e91d71d825: obsolete — Explicit source-root capture worker/job API was removed with turn-gated control; those worker-delivery scenarios have no current worker to exercise.
